snippet.title: Is Gen Z cooked?
snippet.description:
Is Gen Z cooked?
I've been thinking about this a lot. The economy. The housing market. Online dating. The hopelessness showing up in every comment section and every social media post from young men who can't see a way forward.
I don't think the answer is just work harder. That advice doesn't cut it anymore and anyone telling you that hasn't been paying attention.
But I also want to tell you what true poor looks like.
My grandfather was an Okie. In the 1930s his family had 80 acres in Oklahoma — completely self-sufficient, raised their own food, their own cattle, made their own butter. Didn't depend on anyone.
Then the Dust Bowl came and took everything.
They packed three vehicles and headed west to Idaho with nothing. Pregnant women. Little kids. Canvas wall tents in sub-zero winters. They didn't know how to log. They didn't know the Pacific Northwest. But they didn't lay down either.
I'm holding his axe right now.
This video is for the young man who is struggling. Who can't see the point. Who has been dealt a genuinely hard hand and knows it.
The best is yet to come. I believe that.
May God bless you and your families.
— Cody
